_comment: d1 #247 Friends of the Inn -- RE-DERIVED for PR2a (roster grew APPEND-ONLY to [selys,krshia,olesm,pisces], seats still 2). The fixture banks all four met at times_slept=10, so WIInnGuests windows a pool of 4 from start = 10%4 = 2: OLESM (3,5) + PISCES (6,5) are on shift and the pilot pair is OFF. That makes this the first script where the rotation is proven LIVE rather than unit-only. Legs: (1) PRESENCE-WHEN-ON-SHIFT -- both new guests are reachable and interactable; (2) DISPLACEMENT -- Selys's seat (6,6) is walkable this waking (present_when absence is STRUCTURAL: is_cell_blocked/entity_at/_build_entities all skip an off-shift guest), which is also how the route reaches Pisces; (3) CONTEXT AWARENESS -- each opens its OWN inn conversation (olesm_inn/pisces_inn), never olesm_intro's chess/briefing desk or pisces_magic's tutoring, and Pisces's off-duty topic is walked to prove the register is food-and-fire only, no magic and no Door; (4) SERVABLE -- Olesm's Serve consumes the hot_meal and banks the shared served_customer counter (feeds Helper); (5) THE SLIDE -- a real sleep takes times_slept to 11, start = 11%4 = 3, seating PISCES + SELYS: Olesm's seat is now walkable, Pisces is STILL on shift (the window slid one, it did not swap), and Selys is back. INTERACT IDIOM (horns_residence): a click on a non-adjacent entity only WALKS adjacent -- it does not interact -- so each guest is reached by clicking an empty adjacent cell, waiting for arrival, THEN clicking the guest's own cell (now cardinally adjacent -> face + interact). Both new seats sit on row 5, WEST of the armed rift_vermin_leak (9,7) and clear of the serve lane (4,7)/(5,7)/(6,7) + hungry_patron (5,6). Boot = fixture->manual slot, title Continue (down 1), same as horns_residence/save_port_loop.

steps._comment: Exactly TWO of the four guest rows render this waking -- the seat count never grows with the roster. Off-shift rows are structurally absent, so they contribute no sprite (present_when, unlike visual_states `hidden`). 23 = 16 ungated entities + hungry_patron (day) + the 3 _returned Horns (door_mounted) + olesm + pisces + the PC. from_start because the boot render lands before world_ready, ahead of this step's since-marker.

== OLESM: on shift + inn register + serve == his seat is (3,5). Walk to (3,6) just below it, then click (3,5) to interact. His OWN conversation opens directly (single interact, no bark -- the guest rows carry no talk_pool).

payload_contains.speaker: Olesm
payload_contains.text: Oh, good, a friendly face. I promised myself one night off and I have spent it counting how many people can reach that door before I can.

steps._comment: Serve is visible option 1 (hot_meal held + not yet served this waking, both legs of the {once_per_waking, item} compound met). Effects: bank the serve key, served_customer++, gold+2, consume the hot_meal -> goto served.

payload_contains.speaker: Olesm
payload_contains.text: Oh. That is properly hot. I had it in my head I would eat later, and later has been three hours away all evening. Thank you. I mean that in the plain way, not the polite way.

steps._comment: == DISPLACEMENT == Selys's seat (6,6) is OFF SHIFT this waking, so the cell is plain floor -- the player walks onto it. That is the negative half of the rotation (the pilot pair really is displaced, not merely un-greeted) and it doubles as the approach to Pisces at (6,5). The route detours via row 7 because hungry_patron (5,6) still blocks the direct line.

== PISCES: on shift + register-pure off-duty topic == (6,5), directly north of the seat the player is standing in. The hot_meal is spent, so his Serve renders VISIBLE-LOCKED ('requires Hot Meal') rather than hidden -- an item gate is a grey tease, not a secret. The topic is therefore visible option 2.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: You are the one with the trays. I am not here for the cuisine, you understand, nor to discuss my work over it. The fire is adequate. My rooms are not.

options.text: Bring him a bowl from the kitchen. (Serve)

steps._comment: His ONE off-duty topic: food and travel, no magic, no necromancy, no Door -- the register-purity proof that the guest row never borrows pisces_magic's tutoring or the door_mounting beat that shares this map.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: Tavern fare is a solved problem. Salt, fat, and enough of it that nobody asks a second question. I have eaten better in three cities. I have eaten considerably worse in nine. I decline to say where this kitchen falls between them.

steps._comment: Serve stays visible-locked on this node too, so the exit is visible option 2.
== THE SLIDE == a real sleep at your_bed (the inn's only bed, upstairs) takes times_slept 10 -> 11, so start goes 2 -> 3 and the window seats [pisces, selys]. olesm_chess_loop's exact bed idiom.

Still exactly two seats filled after the slide -- the same two seats, different people. 23 -> 24 is NOT a third guest: the sleep completed the resonant_catalyst attunement and banked garden_door_unlocked, so the always-authored garden_door (3,8) turns present in the same rebuild (event log: accomplishment_recorded garden_door_unlocked fires inside the sleep beat, before this render).
OLESM ROTATED OUT: the seat he occupied an hour ago is walkable now. A blocked move would have left the player at (3,6).
PISCES STAYED: he is in BOTH windows (start 2 -> [olesm,pisces], start 3 -> [pisces,selys]), which is what makes this a slide and not a swap. Approach from (5,5), the free cell west of his seat.
Exit is visible option 3 on the greet: the sleep cleared entity_first_use, so the once_per_waking leg is armed again, but the hot_meal is still spent, so Serve stays visible-locked in slot 1.

SELYS ROTATED BACK IN: her (6,6) seat was plain floor before the sleep and is occupied again now. Reached the long way round -- Pisces (6,5), hungry_patron (5,6) and the map's own (7,6) all block the direct lines.

payload_contains.speaker: Selys
payload_contains.text: You actually work here? That explains why the stew smells like something worth queuing for.
